rationale: Denial code ranking with scope=denied_claims shows code frequency and share within denied claims, with default quantify_missing=overall addressing missing codes. Denial rate by segment across all five requested dimensions answers rate variation by claim type, specialty, network status, place of service, and auth requirement. Denominator corrected to adjudicated_claims (Paid, Denied, Adjusted) and min_group_size set to 30 to flag segments with fewer than 30 claims as unstable, addressing statistical discipline feedback. Report documents results with descriptive_only caveat.
changes_summary: Corrected denial_rate_by_segment denominator from all_claims to adjudicated_claims (Paid, Denied, Adjusted claims) and set min_group_size from 0 to 30. These changes address high-severity statistical discipline feedback and will recalculate segment rates and denominators with correct parameters.
